description: Machine-readable index of the OpenAPI catalog. One entry per spec in openapi/, plus 'expected' entries for providers that publish a spec that is not mirrored here yet. Checked by scripts/ci/check-catalog-index.mjs (ci/test); provider drift is reported by scripts/catalog/check-provider-drift.sh.

statusVocabulary.mirrored: Catalog file is byte-identical to the provider spec on the provider's main branch at driftCheck.checkedAt.
statusVocabulary.drifted: Catalog file differs from the provider spec on the provider's main branch. Fix with a catalog mirror PR, never by editing the catalog first.
statusVocabulary.provider-missing: The owning provider repo has no spec on main, so the catalog copy has no upstream.
statusVocabulary.catalog-only: Spec exists only in this catalog (seeded from the monolith) and no provider publishes it.
statusVocabulary.expected: Provider publishes a spec on main but the catalog has no mirror yet (file is null).

driftCheck.method: git blob comparison of openapi/<file> against <providerRepo> origin/main:<providerSpecPath>; open PRs listed from the GitHub REST API
